hero.title: Our Spaces
hero.subtitle: Monte do Papa Léguas offers two types of accommodation: double rooms with private bathroom, and studios with double bedroom, private bathroom, kitchenette and porch with dining area.
hero.imageAlt: Interior of a room at Monte do Papa Léguas

quartos.heading: The Rooms
description: Comfortable and welcoming, our rooms offer a spacious bed (double or 2 separate beds, as you prefer), modern bathroom with shower, heating, TV, wardrobe and a minifridge, ensuring a pleasant and practical stay.

atmospheric: Double bed (double or 2 separate beds, as preferred)

imageAlts: Room at Monte do Papa Léguas — view 2

estudios.heading: The Studios
estudios.tagline: Ideal for those who want more autonomy
description: The Studio is ideal for those who want more autonomy. Our Studios are in a separate block from the main Monte and have a parking space next to Monte dos Estudios.

atmospheric: Equipped kitchenette (utensils, minibar, induction hob, microwave, electric kettle and toaster)
Double bed (or 2 single beds, as you prefer)
premium: Option to add an extra bed, ideal for family holidays
Parking space next to Monte dos Estúdios
